integrity: The bijection was reconstructed from the finite nested-equivalence structure and independently replayed by recursive enumeration of ordered nested partitions for d<=3 and n<=5; the repeated-tuple identities were checked through d<=5 and n<=8.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for Braunfeld's minimal successor-order expansion of a finite chain. Extra subquotient orders, non-chain lattices, or reducts can have different orbit profiles. Ordered-Bell/Fubini polynomial identities are prior combinatorics; originality is restricted to the model-theoretic colored-gap identification and its profile consequences.
title: Colored-gap orbit profiles for minimal chain ultrametric expansions
